# Amine Triki

> Tunisian full-stack developer building websites, landing pages, e-commerce stores, web apps and Android apps (React, Next.js, Flutter), working in English, French and Arabic.

## Key facts

- Starting price: landing page — 500 TND
- Starting price: business website — 900 TND
- Starting price: e-commerce website — 2,500 TND
- Starting price: web application — 5,000 TND
- Starting price: simple Android app — 800 TND
- The client owns the domain, hosting and app-store accounts.
- The code belongs to the client after final payment.
- Two revision rounds are included.
- Maintenance after delivery is priced separately.
